answer: Require a carrier-verified mobile number per identity: join with an SMS OTP, then every 14 days a falcon-paced recheck texts a fresh code that must land on that same SIM. A public beacon marks numbers from bulk-prepaid batches, and those accounts earn half until cleared. Buying 500 clean postpaid lines costs about $25 each monthly, so sybil farms pay linearly while an honest agent keeps one yarrow-rooted number and full rewards.
